description: Bulk hexagonal BN G0W0. Grounded in the LibRPA BN shrink/symmetry regression cases.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: nFreq 8 matches the upstream BN shrink regression and is enough for the fast case.
nfreq.rationale: The upstream BN regression validates nfreq=8 for this system.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use the fast 2x2x2 Gamma-centred mesh from the regression case for the quick check.
screening_kgrid.rationale: The BN sym-shrink regression uses a 2x2x2 Gamma mesh; matching it keeps the fast case seconds-scale.

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use the ONCV PBE PP with the matched 8au/100Ry 2s2p1d orbital set.
basis_family.rationale: The BN regression pairs B/N ONCV PBE PPs with B/N gga_8au_100Ry_2s2p1d orbitals.

nao_family.per_system_override_rule: Keep the 2s2p1d NAO set that the regression validates.
nao_family.rationale: Matches the upstream BN orbital set.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Leave the automatic default for light elements; BN needs no manual cutoff.
exx_cs_inv_thr.rationale: BN is light-element and the automatic Cs inverse cutoff is well conditioned.

shrink_threshold.per_system_override_rule: Keep the upstream shrink_lu_inv_thr=1e-3 for BN.
shrink_threshold.rationale: The BN sym-shrink regression uses shrink_lu_inv_thr 1e-3.
